name: Bluemaxx
summary: Darling Downs (Toowoomba) QLD ISP/telecom (wireless + satellite + ADSL + 3G + VoIP + fixed-line; Bluemaxx Communications, from ~2005); retail site alive to 2012, gone c. 2012.

events.details: Trading as Bluemaxx Communications; wireless broadband, later satellite (IPSTAR), ADSL/ADSL2+, 3G data, fixed-line and VoIP; earliest Wayback capture Mar 2006.
Full retail homepage (ISP/telecom services) still live Feb 2012; domain served only a redirect from 2013.
